derivation: The checkpoint is D2-248's result: branch-a's head completed and discharged its obligation, then a second conclusive record for the same permit and attempt conflicted with the completion evidence, so the completed occurrence's outcomes are disputed and the discharged obligation became DISPUTED with its DIRECT_EVENT basis retained. The record that disputes the head is the CONFLICTING outcome, whose digest differs from the completion evidence digest in the basis. A fresh available CLOCK sample asks the consumer to restart. LIFE-019 admits a completion-based DISPUTED obligation when its frontier intersects the dependency-affected set of a retained completed occurrence with disputed conclusive evidence, and a completed occurrence has such evidence when any retained governed outcome bound to its permit is disputed and asserts an established effect or no effect; it need not be the completion record. The checkpoint is admitted and the CLOCK sample recorded.
